scientific_claim: Exploratory control-derived bundled challenger; hypothesis-generating, not a benchmark-validated optimum.

evaluated_pair_to_retain.name: sigma15_plus_unchanged_control_ci
evaluated_pair_to_retain.warning: This literal evaluated pair uses the unchanged control CI: crop 512, rotation +/-180 degrees, zero jitter, OHKM on, and the control anchor/data policy.

data_expansion.requirement: Add independent, fully mouth-labeled side instances.
data_expansion.alternative: Use an explicit ignored-loss region for missing mouth anchors.
data_expansion.prohibited: Do not include visible fish with missing mouth labels as negative background.
data_expansion.current_opportunity: The audited dropped side frames contain 902 additional finite mouths, approximately 13.15% more than the strict targets, but their missing anchors must be completed or loss-ignored before use.

centered_instance.missing_mouth_policy: Exclude only the individual centered-instance sample whose mouth coordinate is non-finite; retain other eligible instances from the same frame.

required_comparators.name: broad_regression_reference
required_comparators.purpose: Sigma 2.0 plus unchanged control CI was the broad three-experiment stress favorite.

required_comparators.name: identical_hybrid_with_ohkm_on
required_comparators.purpose: Isolate the OHKM decision while holding crop, rotation, jitter, data eligibility, initialization, and seed fixed.

interpretation.sigma_1_5: Best centroid and full-top-down coverage on the single pilot event; sigma 2.0 remained better on the broader stress cohort.
interpretation.unchanged_control_ci: Won exact-mouth oracle centered-instance evaluation in both diagnostic cohorts.
interpretation.crop_rotation_ohkm_strict_bundle: Not validated as an improvement. The evaluated optimized bundles changed these factors together and underperformed the unchanged control.
interpretation.jitter_16: Rejected due to brittle high-percentile tail failures.
interpretation.jitter_0: Chosen here to retain the control's zero-jitter condition and avoid repeating the rejected +/-16 px setting.

promotion_requires: fully labeled and partial-label metrics reported separately
no regression in all-three detection coverage, tail p99, shared-tail rate, or swap rate
